content.title: 2017 High Blood Pressure Clinical Practice Guideline

sections.title: Follow-Up After Initial BP Evaluation
sections.details: Analysis from the SPRINT trial shows the importance of treating systolic blood pressure to reduce cardiovascular risk.

sections.title: General Principles of Drug Therapy
sections.details: Various drugs are advised for treatment, such as Telmisartan and experimental antihypertensive therapies for those with hypertension.
Study findings present a reduction in mortality and improved health outcomes when systolic blood pressure is treated and managed effectively.
